detection.rule: every publishable unit declared in a provider's repository marketplace is a potential carrier (worst case: any unit may be enabled); every root projection is a carrier; an identity with ≥2 carriers is a collision and needs an owner record

provenance_note.note: the committed prose runtime inventory carries no identity record, no unit list and no version; it corroborates nothing machine-comparable and is never the diff source of collision detection (D44)

observed.role: corroboration only: it can never remove a collision from the repo-derived set, and an unreadable provider stays `unknown`
